scientific_integrity: The theorem and remainder estimates are analytical. The standalone checker tests numerical identities only. No guarantee is made about exact finite-sample tail probabilities from the asymptotic formula.
scientific_limitations: Uniformity requires bounded critical-window parameters and positive x bounded away from zero. The extreme-value theorem is for independent rows of a triangular array with exactly specified shape drift, not arbitrary nonstationary samples. Related fixed-shape regular variation is prior knowledge; mathematical priority over potentially unindexed equivalent moving-shape theory is not certified.
title: Critical-window extreme-value crossover for the slashed inverse-Rayleigh law
